content.query:
// VERIFY: LogicAppWorkflowRuntime table and WorkflowName, Status, and TimeGenerated columns.
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| where WorkflowName startswith "wf-j"
| summarize Succeeded = countif(Status == "Succeeded"), Failed = countif(Status == "Failed") by WorkflowName
| order by WorkflowName asc

// VERIFY: LogicAppWorkflowRuntime table and WorkflowName, DurationMs, and TimeGenerated columns.
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| where WorkflowName startswith "wf-j"
| summarize DurationP50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), DurationP95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by WorkflowName
| order by WorkflowName asc

// VERIFY: LogicAppWorkflowRuntime table and parse_json(TrackedProperties).filesProcessed, WorkflowName, and TimeGenerated fields.
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| where WorkflowName startswith "wf-j"
| summarize FilesProcessed = sum(toint(parse_json(TrackedProperties).filesProcessed)) by WorkflowName, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Day desc

items.name: Files processed per job and day

content.query:
// VERIFY: LogicAppWorkflowRuntime table and parse_json(TrackedProperties).errorCode, Status, and TimeGenerated fields.
LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| where WorkflowName startswith "wf-j"
| where Status == "Failed"
| summarize Failures = count() by ErrorCode = tostring(parse_json(TrackedProperties).errorCode)
| order by Failures desc

// VERIFY: AzureDiagnostics table and Category, ResultType, WorkerName, and TimeGenerated columns for Automation JobLogs.
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| where Category == "JobLogs"
| summarize Jobs = count() by Status = ResultType, Worker = tostring(WorkerName)
| order by Jobs desc

items.name: Automation jobs by status and worker
